summary: Separate governance runtime namespace from Wellman execution CLI

delivery.outcome: Ship a governance-only distribution and module namespace that can coexist with the full Wellman execution CLI, preserve trusted old CI runtime pins, and distinguish static conformance from runtime mediation.
nonGoals: No replacement of protected runtime pins or fleet rollout
No direct PyPI publication, approval bypass or global executable replacement before reviewed publication
No copied execution implementation or filesystem-sandbox claim

architecture.decision: Publish wellmanifest-governance with module wellmanifest_governance_runtime and command wellman-governance. Keep the existing source directory to preserve bundle-generation ownership. Isolated CI resolves only declared installed entry-point identities: new governance runtime or the pinned legacy wellman.check runtime, never the unrelated catalogue CLI. The canonical full Wellman retains wellman and owns project execution; managed instructions require its explicitly enrolled project-bound launcher.
interfaceChanges: Protected CI admits only explicit governance runtime entry points
Static governance JSON explicitly reports runtime enforcement not checked
architecture.rollback: Keep protected immutable legacy pins and published legacy wheels unchanged; restore prior reviewed selector/standard adoption if an independently qualified rollout fails.
